title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 Generic DNR Information Work Item
summary: Add focused proof and one explicit metadata flag for the shared RFC 9463 DNR information surface.
planned_changes:
- Add focused tests for ADN presence, resolver-address preservation, service parameters, ADN-only mode, service priority, DHCPv6 ORO data, OPTION_V6_DNR non-singleton status, and DHCPv4 option-data length.
- Expose OPTION_V6_DNR non-singleton status as explicit metadata.
- Add canonical xrefs and trace artifacts for the remaining RFC 9463 generic requirements.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused generic-information tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Platform DHCP and Router Advertisement integration.
completion_notes: The shared RFC 9463 DNR information surface is now fully trace-owned across scalar, DHCPv4, DHCPv6, and Neighbor Discovery helpers.
